summary: A split dialog with a media panel beside a lead form containing name, email and a Save button.
use: Detail or onboarding dialogs that pair an image or summary with a short form.
spec: Two direct children: `<div class="media">` labelled Media / summary and `<div class="form">`
Form uses `<Stack gap="3.5">` with `<TextField label="Full name" bind:value={name}` and `<TextField label="Email" type="email" bind:value={email}`
